armies.name: The Empire
armies.subtitle: Faith, steel and gunpowder
armies.description: Build an Empire army using State Troops, Knightly Orders, Wizards, War Machines and auxiliary forces.

armies.name: High Elves
armies.subtitle: The hosts of Ulthuan
armies.description: Build a High Elf army with disciplined infantry, elite warriors, swift cavalry, mages, dragons, chariots and bolt throwers.

armies.name: Orcs & Goblins
armies.subtitle: A tide of green anarchy
armies.description: Test the developing Orcs & Goblins army with Orcs, Goblins, cavalry, monsters, chariots, shamans and special characters.

armies.name: Dwarfs
armies.subtitle: Ancient holds and unbreakable resolve
armies.description: Test the Dwarf army with elite infantry, Slayers, Runesmiths, runic items, artillery, Gyrocopters and special characters.

armies.name: Skaven
armies.subtitle: The teeming children of the Horned Rat
armies.description: Test Skaven with Clanrat mainstay rules, expendable hordes, elite clans, Rat Ogres, weapon teams, warpstone engines and notorious special characters.

armies.name: Vampire Counts
armies.subtitle: Bloodlines, necromancy and the restless dead
armies.description: Test Vampire Counts with the five bloodlines, bloodline powers, core undead regiments, monsters and Von Carstein special characters.

armies.name: Tomb Kings
armies.subtitle: The deathless legions of Nehekhara
armies.description: Test Tomb Kings with Mummy royalty, Undead Priests, Tomb Guard, chariots, constructs, scorpions, catapults and the Casket of Souls.

armies.name: Classic Undead
armies.subtitle: The mixed legions of old
armies.description: Test the Classic Undead army with Liches, Necromancers, Wights, Vampires, Mummies and the mixed regiments of the old Undead list.

armies.name: Chaos Warriors
armies.subtitle: Armoured champions of the Dark Gods
armies.description: Build a pure Chaos Warriors army with Champions, Sorcerers, Marauders, Warriors, Knights, chariots, monsters and Marks of Chaos.

armies.name: Beastmen
armies.subtitle: The savage children of Chaos
armies.description: Build a pure Beastmen army with Gors, Ungors, Bestigors, Minotaurs, Dragon Ogres, Centaurs, monsters and Ambush.

armies.name: Chaos Daemons
armies.subtitle: The hosts beyond the veil
armies.description: Build a pure Daemon army using the servants of Khorne, Tzeentch, Nurgle, Slaanesh and Chaos Undivided.

armies.name: Chaos Warband
armies.subtitle: One Dark Power, many servants
armies.description: Build a mixed Warriors, Beastmen and Daemons force dedicated to one Chaos Power, chosen at the start of army building.

armies.name: Chaos Warhost
armies.subtitle: The united hosts of Chaos
armies.description: Build a 2,000+ point mixed Chaos force combining Warriors, Beastmen, Daemons and followers of different Chaos Powers.

armies.name: Chaos Dwarfs
armies.subtitle: Tyrants of the Dark Lands
armies.description: Test the Chaos Dwarfs with High Hats, slave regiments, Bull Centaurs, sorcery and artillery, with selectable Classic, Old School and Modern army styles.

armies.name: Dark Elves
armies.subtitle: The cruel hosts of Naggaroth
armies.description: Test Dark Elves with ruthless infantry, Witch Elves, Assassins, Dark Riders, Cold Ones, monsters, chariots, sorcery and the Witch King's champions.

armies.name: Wood Elves
armies.subtitle: Guardians of the deep forest
armies.description: Test Wood Elves with selectable Classic and Savage army styles, forest spirits, scouts, cavalry, chariots, Treemen, Sprites and optional Zoat allies.

armies.name: The Grand Army of Bretonnia
armies.subtitle: Knights, peasants and chivalry
